settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the language for the Context Canvas interface.
codex.title: Import Codex session
codex.description: No hook or background service is required. Codex exports a local file, then the browser parses it on this machine.
codex.copyCopied: Export instruction copied. Switch to the target Codex task, paste it, and send it.
codex.copyFailed: The browser could not copy automatically. Use the button to copy it.
codex.stepOneTitle: Send the instruction in the target Codex task
codex.stepOneBody: Codex uses the unique marker to locate this rollout and exports the records before the instruction.
codex.stepTwoTitle: Allow the required local file permissions
codex.stepTwoBody: If prompted, allow reading the Codex sessions directory and writing the Context Canvas Imports folder.
codex.stepThreeBody: The original session file is not changed and content is not uploaded.
codex.dropHint: or click to choose a .jsonl file
codex.boundaryVerified: Import boundary verified: the export instruction and Codex response are excluded. Tools and sub-agent records are marked needs review and are excluded from the bundle by default.
codex.boundaryWaiting: The file will be checked against the unique marker or export filename before import.
complex.noBlocks: No readable blocks in this turn.
